column1: # manifests/mcp.tsv — MCP servers, installed into every listed agent by `add-mcp`.
#   name       The server name in every agent's config. Set here, never on the
#              command line: three `codex mcp add copilotkit …` calls with three
#              different URLs left Codex holding only the last one.
#   transport  stdio — target is an npm package run under `npx -y`.
#              http / sse — target is a URL.
#   agents     `add-mcp` agent arguments. Copilot CLI is deliberately absent; it
#              has no binary on this host. OpenCode reads the same store, but its
#              MCP config is separate and does need a row entry.
